title: Barber: one to two craft a year recovered over his range

tellings.quote: public, he would say over his specific range 1 to two a year.

plain: Over a single test range, one or two unexplained craft a year are recovered, according to a man named Jake Barber, who has spoken about such recoveries in public. A guest who goes by the online name UAPGerb repeats Barber's figure to Michels while explaining how a hidden Pentagon UFO programme works. If true, retrieving downed craft would be routine work, not a one-off.
